sections.en: Conjunction of the Moon with Mars

summary.headline: Moon–Mars Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of the Moon and Mars in Leo, Sagittarius, the earthy triplicity, Taurus, and Virgo, including war, disease, weather, famine, political deaths, social unrest, and damage to animals, crops, roads, and markets. The forecasts distinguish outcomes when Mars or the Moon is ascendant and mention Babylon, Iraq, Fars, and the Maghreb.
